newsitem.title: FINLAND: INCAP SEES HELSINKI OTC-LISTING START AROUND MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: INCAP SEES HELSINKI OTC-LISTING START AROUND MAY 5.

text.p: Finnish electronic and furniture subcontractor Incap Oy said in a statement on Friday it had decided to seek a listing of its share on the OTC-list, and said it expected trading in its share to start around May 5.
"The Incap group's net sales are expected to grow significantly this year," the group said in an appendix to the statement.
Incap had a 1996 operating profit of 16.4 million markka on net sales of 216.7 million, it said.
"Business (this year) at both Incap Electronics Oy and Incap Furniture Oy has been clearly brisker and the orderbooks are good," it said.

"The business operations of Incap Electronics Oy are expected to expand owing to growth of its current clientele, and growth of the business is being ensured by expansion measures especially at the company's Helsinki plant," it said.

"The performance of Incap Furniture Oy will be affected by growth of the furniture industry which is expected to follow the growth of economies in the company's future main markets in Europe, North America and Southeast Asia," it said.
Higher raw-material prices and the stronger Finnish currency were sources of uncertainty for the furniture business, Incap said.
